name: Microsoft tool
short: A software product or service developed by Microsoft.

name: AI assistant
short: Software that uses AI models to help users write, summarise, search or act.

name: Low-code tool
short: A tool for building apps and automations with little or no programming.

name: Analytics and BI tool
short: A tool for analysing data and building reports and dashboards.

name: Identity and security tool
short: A tool for protecting identities, devices, data and applications.

name: Collaboration tool
short: A tool for communication, meetings and working together on files.

name: Cloud platform
short: A platform providing computing, storage and services over the internet.

name: Developer tool
short: A tool that helps developers write, test and ship software.

name: Business application
short: Software for business processes such as sales, finance or customer service.

name: Microsoft
short: Microsoft Corporation is a technology company that develops software and cloud services such as Microsoft 365, Azure and Dynamics 365.

name: GitHub
short: GitHub is a platform for hosting code and collaborating on software projects; it is part of Microsoft.

name: Microsoft 365
short: Microsoft 365 is a subscription bundle of productivity apps and cloud services, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.

name: Microsoft Azure
short: Microsoft Azure is Microsoft's cloud platform with services for computing, storage, networking, databases, analytics and AI.

name: Microsoft Entra
short: Microsoft Entra is the family of identity and network access products from Microsoft, including Microsoft Entra ID.

name: Microsoft Entra ID

name: Multifactor authentication (MFA)

name: Microsoft Purview
short: Microsoft's family of data governance, protection and compliance tools. It covers sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, retention, eDiscovery, audit and insider-risk management across Microsoft 36

name: Sensitivity labels
short: Labels from Microsoft Purview that classify and protect documents, emails and meetings. A label can add encryption, visual markings and access restrictions that travel with the file wherever it goes.

name: Data loss prevention (DLP)
short: Policies that detect sensitive information such as credit card numbers or personal data and prevent it from being shared, copied or uploaded in ways that violate company rules.

name: Microsoft Defender

name: Microsoft Intune
short: Microsoft's cloud service for managing devices and apps. It enforces configuration and compliance policies on Windows, macOS, iOS and Android and feeds device status into Conditional Access.

name: Microsoft Graph
short: The unified API for Microsoft 365 data and services such as users, mail, calendar, files, Teams and security. Developers use one endpoint and one permission model; Copilot also uses Graph to ground an

name: OneDrive
short: Microsoft's cloud storage for personal work files. It syncs folders across devices and integrates with SharePoint, sharing controls and Microsoft 365 apps.

name: Exchange Online
short: The cloud email, calendar and contacts service in Microsoft 365. Outlook connects to it, and mail flow rules, anti-phishing and retention policies are managed around it.

name: Microsoft Viva
short: A set of employee-experience apps inside Teams and Microsoft 365, including Viva Engage for communities, Viva Insights for work patterns and Viva Learning for training.

name: Power Pages
short: Power Pages is a low-code service for building secure, data-driven business websites.

name: Dataverse
short: The managed data platform behind Power Platform and Dynamics 365. It stores tables with relationships, security roles and business logic, so apps and agents work on one governed data source.

name: Microsoft Fabric
short: An all-in-one analytics platform that combines data engineering, data warehousing, real-time analytics and Power BI on a shared storage layer called OneLake, billed through shared capacity.

name: Dynamics 365
short: Microsoft's family of business applications for sales, customer service, finance, supply chain and more, including Business Central for small and mid-sized companies. It builds on Dataverse and Power

name: GitHub Copilot
short: An AI coding assistant that suggests code, explains it, writes tests and, in agent mode, carries out multi-step changes in a repository under the developer's review.

name: AI agent
short: A software system that uses an AI model to pursue a goal on its own: it plans steps, calls tools or APIs, reads data and acts, often with a human approving critical steps. Agents go beyond chatbots be

name: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
short: A pattern in which an AI model first retrieves relevant documents from a knowledge source and then writes its answer based on them. It reduces made-up answers and lets models use current, private data

name: Prompt
short: The instruction or question given to an AI model. Clear prompts state the goal, the context, the desired format and any constraints; good prompting is the fastest way to better Copilot results.

name: Prompt injection
short: An attack in which hidden or malicious instructions in a document, web page or email trick an AI system into ignoring its rules or leaking data. Defences include limiting permissions, filtering inputs

name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
short: An open protocol that lets AI applications connect to tools and data sources in a standard way. An MCP server exposes capabilities, and any compatible agent can discover and call them.

name: Governance
short: The rules, roles and controls that define who may use which data and tools, and how that is monitored. For Copilot and agents, governance covers permissions, labelling, lifecycle of agents and auditab

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
short: Entry-level certification covering basic cloud concepts and core Azure services.

name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals (MS-900)
short: Entry-level Microsoft 365 fundamentals exam. Retired on 31 March 2026; Microsoft plans no direct replacement (see AB-900 for Copilot and agent administration).

name: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
short: Entry-level certification covering security, compliance and identity concepts with Microsoft solutions.

name: Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)
short: Entry-level certification covering the business value and core components of Power Platform.

name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
short: Entry-level exam on AI and machine learning concepts and Azure AI services. The AI-900 exam retired on 30 June 2026; the certification continues with the refreshed AI-901.

name: M365.FM
short: M365.FM is a podcast about Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure, Power Platform and security, hosted by Mirko Peters.

name: M365Con 2027
short: M365Con is a free, 100% online conference for the Microsoft community with 120 sessions, January 11–22, 2027.

name: AI governance
short: Policies, roles and controls that keep the use of AI in an organisation safe, compliant and accountable.

name: EU AI Act
short: The European Union regulation that sets risk-based rules for developing and using AI systems.

name: Compliance
short: Meeting legal, regulatory and internal requirements, for example for data protection and records retention.

name: GDPR
short: The EU General Data Protection Regulation governing how personal data may be processed.

name: Audit logs
short: Records of who did what and when in a system, used for security investigations and compliance.

name: eDiscovery
short: Finding, holding and exporting electronic content for legal or investigative cases.

name: Human in the loop
short: A design principle where a person reviews or approves what an AI system or automation does.

name: Azure OpenAI Service
short: A service that provides OpenAI models such as GPT through Azure with enterprise security and compliance.

name: GPT-5
short: A generation of large language models from OpenAI used in products such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot.

name: ChatGPT
short: An AI chat assistant from OpenAI.

name: Azure API Management
short: A service for publishing, securing, throttling and monitoring APIs.

name: Azure AI Search
short: A search service that indexes content and supports vector and hybrid search, often used for RAG.

name: Azure Key Vault
short: A service for securely storing secrets, keys and certificates.

name: Azure Cosmos DB
short: A globally distributed NoSQL database service on Azure.

name: Active Directory
short: The on-premises directory service for Windows domains that manages users, computers and permissions.

name: Microsoft Entra Connect
short: Software that synchronises on-premises Active Directory identities with Microsoft Entra ID.

name: Microsoft Entra Domain Services
short: Managed domain services such as domain join, LDAP and Kerberos in Azure without running domain controllers.

name: Microsoft Defender for Identity
short: A security service that detects threats against on-premises identities, such as lateral movement and Kerberoasting.

name: Microsoft 365 admin center
short: The web portal for administering users, licences and services in a Microsoft 365 tenant.

name: Viva Engage
short: The enterprise social network in Microsoft Viva, the successor to Yammer.

name: Viva Insights
short: Microsoft Viva service that shows work patterns and wellbeing insights for individuals and teams.

name: Viva Learning
short: Microsoft Viva service that brings learning content such as LinkedIn Learning into Teams.

name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
short: A Dynamics 365 application for managing support cases and customer service operations.

name: Dynamics 365 Sales
short: A Dynamics 365 application for managing leads, opportunities and the sales pipeline.

name: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights
short: A customer data platform and journey tool in Dynamics 365 for unified customer profiles and segmentation.

name: Power Platform CLI
short: A command-line tool for developing, packaging and deploying Power Platform components.

name: Visual Studio Code
short: A free, extensible code editor from Microsoft.

name: GitHub Actions
short: A CI/CD and automation service built into GitHub.

name: Teams Toolkit
short: Developer tooling for building apps and agents for Microsoft Teams.

name: Kusto Query Language (KQL)
short: The query language used in Microsoft Sentinel, Defender and Azure Monitor to analyse log data.

name: Change notifications and webhooks
short: A Microsoft Graph pattern that pushes notifications when data changes, instead of polling, often combined with delta query.

name: Copilot adoption
short: Rolling out Copilot to users and getting them to use it effectively, including training, change management and measuring ROI.

name: Copilot governance
short: Controls for permissions, data access and oversight when using Copilot in a Microsoft 365 tenant.

name: Automation
short: Using software to run repetitive tasks and processes without manual work.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
short: Associate certification for managing Azure identities, storage, compute, networking and monitoring.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
short: Expert certification for designing identity, data, business-continuity and infrastructure solutions on Azure.

name: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
short: Expert certification for DevOps practices with Azure DevOps and GitHub: pipelines, source control and delivery.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
short: Associate certification for designing, implementing and maintaining Azure networking solutions.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty (AZ-140)
short: Specialty certification for planning, delivering and managing Azure Virtual Desktop environments.

name: Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
short: Expert certification for designing Zero Trust strategies and security architectures across Microsoft cloud services.

name: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
short: Associate certification for threat detection and response with Defender, Sentinel and KQL.

name: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
short: Associate certification for identity, authentication, access management and governance with Microsoft Entra.

name: Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401)
short: Associate certification for information protection, data loss prevention and insider risk with Microsoft Purview.

name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700)
short: Associate certification for planning, configuring and managing Microsoft Teams, meetings and calling.

name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)

name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)

name: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)

name: Power BI Desktop
short: Free Windows application for connecting to data, modelling it and authoring Power BI reports before publishing them to the Power BI service.

name: Power BI Service
short: Cloud service of Power BI for publishing, sharing and refreshing reports, dashboards and semantic models, with workspaces, apps and row-level security.

name: Power Automate Desktop
short: Robotic process automation (RPA) tool for Windows that records and runs desktop flows to automate repetitive tasks in desktop and web applications.

name: AI Builder
short: Power Platform capability that adds prebuilt and custom AI models, such as document processing, text classification and prompts, to apps and flows.

name: Power Platform admin center
short: Central portal for administering Power Platform environments, data policies, capacity, tenant settings and analytics.

name: Power Virtual Agents
short: Former no-code chatbot builder of the Power Platform; it was merged into Microsoft Copilot Studio.

name: Canvas app
short: Power Apps app type where the maker designs the screen layout freely, like a slide, and connects it to data with Power Fx formulas.

name: Model-driven app
short: Power Apps app type generated from the Dataverse data model, with forms, views and business process flows laid out automatically.

name: Connector
short: Prebuilt wrapper around an API that lets Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio read and write data in hundreds of services.

name: Microsoft 365 Apps
short: The installable Office applications of Microsoft 365, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and OneNote, delivered and updated through subscription.

name: Microsoft PowerPoint
short: Presentation software of Microsoft 365 for slides, templates, animations and live presenting, with co-authoring and Copilot-generated decks.

name: Microsoft Outlook
short: Email, calendar, contacts and tasks client of Microsoft 365 that connects to Exchange Online and other mail accounts.

name: Outlook on the web
short: Browser version of Outlook for mail, calendar and contacts, hosted by Exchange Online.

name: Microsoft OneNote
short: Digital notebook for typed notes, ink, images and web clippings, organised in notebooks, sections and pages and synced through OneDrive.

name: Microsoft Access
short: Desktop database application for building small relational databases with tables, queries, forms and reports.

name: Microsoft Publisher
short: Desktop publishing application for flyers, newsletters and brochures; Microsoft ended support in October 2026.

name: Microsoft Visio
short: Diagramming application for flowcharts, org charts, network and process diagrams, available as desktop app and Visio for the web.

name: Microsoft Project
short: Project management software for schedules, resources and Gantt charts; cloud scheduling continues in Planner premium.

name: Office on the web
short: Browser versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Outlook that run without installation and support real-time co-authoring.

name: Word for the web
short: Browser version of Word for writing and co-authoring documents without installing the desktop app.

name: PowerPoint for the web
short: Browser version of PowerPoint for creating, presenting and co-authoring slide decks.

name: Teams Phone
short: Cloud telephony in Microsoft Teams with calling plans, direct routing and operator connect for business phone numbers.

name: Teams Premium
short: Add-on licence for Teams with advanced meeting protection, branded meetings, AI-generated recaps and webinar features.

name: Microsoft Teams Rooms
short: Meeting-room systems with cameras, microphones and displays that join Teams meetings with a single touch.

name: Microsoft Planner
short: Task and project planning tool with boards, buckets, schedules and goals, integrated in Teams as the Planner app.

name: Microsoft To Do
short: Personal task list app with My Day, lists and reminders, synced with Outlook tasks and Planner.

name: Microsoft Forms
short: Tool for creating surveys, quizzes and polls whose responses flow into Excel, Power Automate and Teams.

name: Microsoft Lists
short: Tool for tracking information and work in customisable lists with views, rules and formatting, stored in SharePoint.

name: Microsoft Loop
short: Collaborative workspace with portable Loop components, pages and workspaces that stay in sync across Teams, Outlook and Word.

name: Microsoft Whiteboard
short: Digital canvas for sketching, sticky notes and brainstorming, used in Teams meetings and on devices.

name: Microsoft Bookings
short: Appointment scheduling tool with a public booking page that checks Outlook calendars and sends confirmations.

name: Microsoft Stream
short: Video service of Microsoft 365 where recordings and clips are stored in OneDrive and SharePoint and played back in Teams.

name: Microsoft Clipchamp
short: Browser-based video editor with templates, text-to-speech and stock media, included in Microsoft 365.

name: SharePoint Premium
short: Add-on capabilities for SharePoint such as document processing, content AI, eSignature and advanced management, formerly marketed as Microsoft Syntex.

name: SharePoint Embedded
short: API-first content platform that lets developers store and manage documents for their own apps in Microsoft 365 with its security and compliance.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
short: Secure, web-grounded AI chat for Entra ID users that is included at no extra cost and can run agents; the paid Microsoft 365 Copilot adds work-data grounding.

name: Dynamics 365 Business Central
short: Cloud ERP for small and mid-sized businesses covering finance, sales, purchasing, inventory and operations; successor of Dynamics NAV, extended with AL and agents.

name: Business events (Dynamics 365)
short: Mechanism in Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations that sends a notification to external endpoints such as Logic Apps, Power Automate, Service Bus or Event Grid when a business process event occurs.

name: Data entities (Dynamics 365)
short: Abstractions in Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations that expose business data through OData, data management and Excel for reading, importing and integrating records.

name: Dual-write
short: Near real-time, bi-directional data integration between Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps and Dataverse.

name: Business Performance Analytics
short: Analytics offering for Dynamics 365 ERP data that builds prebuilt reports on Fabric and Power BI and exposes ERP analytics to agents through an MCP server.

name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
short: Identity type in Microsoft Entra for AI agents, so agents get their own identity, permissions and lifecycle instead of borrowing a user's or app's credentials.

name: Microsoft Foundry
short: Microsoft's platform for building, evaluating and operating AI applications and agents with model catalog, agent service, tools, evaluation and observability; formerly Azure AI Foundry.

name: Foundry Agent Service
short: Managed service in Microsoft Foundry for hosting AI agents with threads, tool calling, knowledge, MCP servers and enterprise security.

name: Foundry Local
short: Runtime and CLI for running AI models locally on a PC or device with an OpenAI-compatible API, without sending data to the cloud.

name: Copilot Cowork
short: Capability of Microsoft 365 Copilot where the assistant carries out multi-step work on the user's behalf across Outlook, Teams, Word and Excel, instead of only answering single prompts.

name: Agent skill
short: Reusable package of instructions, scripts and resources that an AI agent loads on demand to perform a specific task consistently.

name: Agent loop
short: Control cycle in which an AI agent plans, calls tools, observes the result and repeats until the goal is reached or it must hand over to a human.

name: Agent harness
short: Software layer around a language model that provides tools, permissions, memory, evaluation and limits so an agent can act safely and reproducibly.

name: Agent observability
short: Collecting traces, metrics, evaluations and audit data of AI agents to see what they did, why, and at what cost.

name: Knowledge source
short: Content an agent in Copilot Studio can ground its answers on, such as SharePoint sites, files, websites, Dataverse tables or connectors.

name: Local-first AI
short: Running AI models and agents on the user's device so data stays local, which can simplify compliance and reduce cloud costs.

name: Vibe coding
short: Building software by describing what you want in natural language and letting an AI generate and refine the code or app.

name: Agentic SDLC
short: Software development lifecycle in which AI agents take part in requirements, coding, testing, review and operations under human oversight.

name: Requirements management
short: Discipline of capturing, structuring, validating and tracing the requirements of a system, increasingly supported by AI.

name: FinOps
short: Practice of managing and optimising cloud and AI spending through cost visibility, allocation, budgets and accountability.

name: Copilot Credits
short: Consumption unit used to bill agent and Copilot Studio usage, which makes budgeting and monitoring of agent costs necessary.

name: Microsoft Fabric Apps
short: Custom, AI-assisted applications and dashboards built on top of Microsoft Fabric data, as an alternative or complement to classic Power BI reports.

name: Rayfin
short: Tool presented at M365Con 2027 for developing Microsoft Fabric Apps with AI-driven development; see the session for details.

name: ERP Analytics MCP
short: MCP server that exposes Dynamics 365 ERP analytics from Business Performance Analytics to AI agents.

name: Dataverse MCP server
short: MCP server that lets agents query and update Dataverse and Dynamics 365 data through the Model Context Protocol, an alternative to connectors.

name: Copilot UX components
short: Reusable user-interface building blocks for extending Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences in custom apps and agents.

name: HTML pages in SharePoint
short: Way to publish custom HTML content as pages in SharePoint, for example generated with AI, within the tenant's security boundary.

name: Generative pages
short: Power Apps feature that generates app pages from a natural-language description on top of Dataverse data, using AI.

name: Power Apps code apps
short: Power Apps app type where developers write the front end in code such as React and still use Power Platform connectors, Dataverse and managed security.

name: Figma
short: Collaborative interface design tool; a plugin turns Figma designs into Power Apps screens for designer-maker hand-off.

name: Semantic model
short: Business-friendly data model of tables, relationships and measures that Power BI reports and Copilot query; formerly called a dataset.

name: Star schema
short: Data model design with a central fact table surrounded by dimension tables; the recommended structure for fast, simple Power BI models.

name: Fabric workspace
short: Container in Microsoft Fabric that groups items such as lakehouses, notebooks and reports and defines access, capacity and deployment boundaries.

name: Fabric task flow
short: Visual design in a Fabric workspace that maps the tasks of a data solution to items, making architecture and ownership visible.

name: Fabric notebooks
short: Notebook experience in Microsoft Fabric for data engineering and data science with PySpark, Python and SQL on lakehouse data.

name: Semantic Link Labs
short: Open-source Python library from Microsoft that automates Power BI and Fabric semantic model management, best-practice checks and migrations from notebooks.

name: Python in Excel
short: Excel feature that runs Python code directly in cells for analysis and visualisation, executed in the Microsoft cloud.

name: SharePoint Advanced Management
short: Set of governance and lifecycle tools for SharePoint, such as site access reviews, inactive site policies, restricted access control and oversharing reports, included with Microsoft 365 Copilot.

name: SharePoint admin agent
short: AI agent that helps SharePoint administrators find and fix tenant problems such as inactive sites, oversharing and permission sprawl in natural language.

name: PnP PowerShell
short: Open-source PowerShell module maintained by the community for managing SharePoint, Teams and Microsoft 365 through Microsoft Graph and CSOM.

name: Tenant-to-tenant migration
short: Moving users, mailboxes, files, Teams and settings from one Microsoft 365 tenant to another, for example after a merger or divestiture.

name: Custom domain in Microsoft 365
short: Own DNS domain verified in Microsoft 365 and used for email addresses, sign-in names and branding, with SPF, DKIM and DMARC records for trust.

name: Zero Trust Assessment
short: Assessment tool that checks a Microsoft 365 and Entra tenant against Zero Trust practices and reports gaps with recommended fixes, going beyond Secure Score.

name: Microsoft Secure Score
short: Measurement in the Microsoft Defender portal that scores a tenant's security posture and suggests improvement actions.

name: Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync
short: Lightweight agent-based synchronisation of on-premises Active Directory to Entra ID, successor to Entra Connect Sync for many scenarios.

name: Identity lifecycle management
short: Automating how identities are created, changed and removed as people join, move within and leave an organisation, via provisioning and lifecycle workflows.

name: Data governance
short: Rules, roles and tools that keep data classified, protected and used correctly, essential before and while deploying Copilot and agents.

name: Azure Functions
short: Serverless compute service of Azure that runs event-driven code; can be exposed as an MCP server, for example through API Management.

name: Azure landing zone
short: Pre-configured Azure environment with management groups, networking, policy and identity that gives workloads a secure, scalable foundation.

name: Sovereign landing zone
short: Azure landing zone variant with sovereignty controls for data residency, encryption and policy, built for regulated and public-sector customers.

name: Infrastructure as code
short: Managing cloud infrastructure through versioned code and automated deployment instead of manual portal clicks.

name: Bicep
short: Domain-specific language from Microsoft for declaring Azure resources, compiled to ARM templates.

name: Terraform
short: Multi-cloud infrastructure-as-code tool from HashiCorp with a provider for Azure.

name: Azure Virtual Desktop
short: Cloud-hosted desktop and app virtualisation service on Azure, extendable to hybrid and other hypervisors.

name: Windows 365
short: Cloud PC service that streams a personal Windows desktop from the Microsoft cloud on a fixed monthly price.

name: .NET
short: Microsoft's open-source, cross-platform developer platform for building web, cloud, desktop, mobile, CLI and AI applications with C#, F# and Visual Basic.

name: Microsoft Flow
short: Former name of Power Automate. Microsoft renamed the workflow service in November 2019; the product continues as Power Automate.

name: Azure Files

short: A Windows feature that lets administrators define settings once in group policy objects (GPOs) and have domain-joined Windows computers and users apply them automatically through Active Directory.

name: Group writeback
short: A Microsoft Entra synchronization feature that provisions cloud-authored groups back to on-premises Active Directory so legacy file servers and applications can still use them for access.

name: gRPC
short: gRPC is an open-source remote procedure call framework originally developed by Google that uses Protocol Buffers to define services and messages across languages.

name: Guest access
short: The ability to add people from outside the organization to Microsoft 365 groups and Teams as guest objects in Microsoft Entra ID, controlled at tenant, team and sensitivity-label level.

name: Hadamard gate

name: Hardware hash

name: Hardware root of trust
short: A security foundation built into a chip that verifies device identity and software integrity before any software loads, so that later security checks can be trusted.

name: Harvest now, decrypt later
short: An attack strategy in which adversaries collect encrypted traffic today and store it until a sufficiently capable quantum computer can decrypt it.

name: HashiCorp Packer
short: Packer is a HashiCorp tool that automates image creation; Azure Image Builder wraps it in an Azure-managed layer.

name: HashiCorp
short: The software company that created Terraform, released in 2014. HashiCorp is now a subsidiary of IBM.

name: Headless commerce
short: Headless commerce separates the selling engine and its business rules from the customer-facing screens, so websites, apps, kiosks or store devices all call the same engine through APIs.

name: Health probe
short: A periodic TCP, HTTP or HTTPS check that a load balancer sends to each backend instance to decide whether it is healthy and should receive new traffic; Azure probes originate from the address 168.63.1

name: Hierarchical partition keys (Azure Cosmos DB)

name: Higgsfield
short: Higgsfield is a generative AI video platform that offers controllable cinematic camera presets, motion control and lip sync tools on top of multiple video models.

name: High availability
short: A system design goal of keeping services operational with minimal downtime, typically achieved through redundancy such as standby replicas.

name: High-context communication

name: High-performance computing (HPC)
short: High-performance computing runs massive parallel jobs such as simulations, rendering or financial modeling across many compute nodes that need shared, high-throughput, low-latency data access.

name: HIPAA
short: The US Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, known in IT for its rules protecting the privacy and security of individually identifiable health information.

name: Hire-to-retire

name: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World)

name: Honeytoken accounts
short: Decoy user accounts with tempting names that have no legitimate use; in Microsoft Defender for Identity any authentication with such an account triggers an alert.

name: Hosted agent
short: An agent type in Foundry Agent Service where you bring your own code and framework and Foundry runs it in an isolated session, scaling it and giving it its own identity.

name: HTTP
short: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the request-response protocol of the web; its methods such as GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE and its numeric status codes form the basis of REST APIs.

name: Hub-and-spoke governance model
short: A federated governance operating model in which a central hub defines policies, baselines, standards and rollout criteria, while local spoke teams execute and remediate them within their own environme

name: Hub-and-spoke network topology
short: Network design in which a central hub virtual network hosts shared services such as a firewall or VPN gateway and is peered with many spoke virtual networks that hold individual workloads.

name: Hybrid cloud
short: Hybrid cloud is an operating model that combines on-premises infrastructure with one or more public clouds under shared identity, policy and management.

name: Microsoft Entra hybrid join
short: Microsoft Entra hybrid join describes Windows devices that are joined to on-premises Active Directory and also registered in Microsoft Entra ID, giving them a cloud identity for access and management.

name: Hybrid RAG
short: A retrieval architecture that routes simple queries to fast single-pass retrieval and complex or ambiguous queries to an agentic path with planning and iteration.

name: Hybrid Runbook Worker

name: Hybrid search
short: Search approach that runs keyword (full-text) and vector queries together and merges the results into one ranked list, for example with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) in Azure AI Search.

name: Hybrid work
short: Hybrid work is a working model in which employees split their time between working in the office and working remotely, which creates the need to coordinate who is in the office and when.

name: Hyper-V
short: Hyper-V is Microsoft's hypervisor for running virtual machines on Windows hosts; Azure Migrate can discover, assess and replicate Hyper-V virtual machines.

name: Hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)
short: Hyperconverged infrastructure is a software-defined design in which the same cluster of servers provides compute, storage and networking, instead of separate server and storage systems.

name: Idempotency

name: Identity threat detection and response (ITDR)

name: Immersive spaces in Microsoft Teams
short: Immersive spaces are a 3D meeting view in Microsoft Teams, powered by Microsoft Mesh, in which participants join as avatars with spatial audio; a space holds up to 16 participants.

name: Immutable backup
short: A backup stored in a write-once-read-many (WORM) state so that recovery points cannot be changed or deleted, even by administrators, until their retention period expires.

name: Immutable storage (WORM)
short: Write once, read many storage behavior, offered for Azure Blob Storage and ADLS Gen2 through time-based retention policies and legal holds, that prevents data from being modified or deleted.

name: Import mode (Power BI)
short: Import is the Power BI storage mode that copies and compresses source data into the semantic model in memory, giving fast reports whose freshness depends on scheduled refresh.

name: Imposter syndrome
short: A psychological pattern in which people doubt their accomplishments and fear being exposed as a fraud, common among high achievers in tech.

name: Improvement actions
short: Recommended tasks in Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager that can be assigned to owners, hold evidence and be tested manually or automatically, and that add points to the compliance score.

name: Inactive site policy (SharePoint)
short: SharePoint Advanced Management site lifecycle policy that detects SharePoint sites without activity for a set period, notifies owners to confirm they are still needed and can make unclaimed sites read

name: Incremental refresh
short: Incremental refresh is a data loading technique that processes only new or changed data since the last run instead of reloading the full data set, used in Power BI and Fabric Dataflow Gen2.

name: Independent software vendor (ISV)
short: An independent software vendor is a software company that builds and sells an app for many customers of a platform, such as Business Central apps offered through Microsoft AppSource.

name: Indicators of compromise (IoC)
short: Pieces of evidence on a network, device or in email, such as malicious IP addresses, domains or file hashes, that suggest an intrusion has happened.

name: Industrial DMZ
short: A separate network zone between plant (OT) and enterprise (IT) networks that hosts selected services under controlled access rules, so exchanges pass through distinct, separately permitted connections

name: Industrial IoT
short: The use of connected sensors, controllers and gateways in industrial settings to capture physical machine and process signals and pass them to digital systems.

name: Infinite capacity planning
short: A rough-cut planning approach that loads demand into time buckets without limiting it to the actual capacity of resources; useful for seeing load build up, but not an executable shop-floor schedule.

name: InfoPath
short: Microsoft InfoPath is a legacy Microsoft tool for designing electronic forms, often used with SharePoint; Power Apps is commonly seen as its successor.

name: Inforcer
short: Inforcer is a company focused on Microsoft 365 security configuration management for managed service providers and their clients. Guest Jonathan Hope works there as an M365 solutions architect.

name: Information architecture
short: The deliberate structuring of sites, content, metadata and navigation so that information can be found and managed; described in the episode as the biggest pain point in SharePoint implementations.

name: Information asymmetry
short: A situation in which one party holds information that the other cannot access. The episode uses it to describe AI agents whose decision paths are opaque to the managers accountable for their outcomes.

name: Microsoft Purview Information Barriers
short: Microsoft Purview compliance solution that restricts two-way communication and collaboration between defined groups or segments of users in Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.

name: Infrastructure chaining
short: A threat intelligence technique that follows shared details such as registrars, certificates, name servers or IP addresses to expand one indicator into a map of related attacker infrastructure.

name: Insecure deserialization
short: Insecure deserialization is a vulnerability in which an application deserializes untrusted data without validation, which can let attackers run arbitrary code or read private data.

name: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
short: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is a compliance solution that correlates activity signals to detect, investigate and act on potentially risky behavior inside an organization.

name: Azure Instance Metadata Service (IMDS)

name: Integration runtime
short: The compute infrastructure in Azure Data Factory that runs activities, acting as the bridge between an activity and a linked service. It comes in three types: Azure, self-hosted and Azure-SSIS.

name: Integration Service Environment (ISE)
short: A retired dedicated hosting option for Azure Logic Apps that placed workflows inside a private network; Microsoft recommends Logic Apps Standard with VNet integration as its successor.

name: Integration testing
short: A software testing practice that verifies components work together with the real services they depend on, such as queues, databases, authentication and configuration.

name: Intelligent document processing (IDP)

name: Intelligent recap

name: Intelligent versioning (SharePoint)
short: Automatic version history setting in SharePoint and OneDrive that caps versions per file and thins older versions over time while preserving recent ones; retention overrides trimming.

name: Intent contract

name: Internal carbon fee

name: Internal developer platform
short: A self-service platform built by a platform team that gives developers curated tools, templates and workflows to build and deploy applications within organizational guardrails.

name: Internet of Things (IoT)
short: The network of physical devices such as sensors, appliances and industrial controllers that connect to the internet to collect and exchange data.

name: Intranet
short: A private company website or network for internal information such as news, policies and tools; classic static intranets suffered from low engagement and poor mobile access.

name: Intrusion detection and prevention system (IDPS)
short: A security capability that monitors network traffic for malicious activity using signatures of known attack patterns and can alert on or block it; in Azure it is a feature of Azure Firewall Premium.

name: Update rings for Windows (Intune)

name: Inventory dimensions
short: In Dynamics 365, inventory dimensions are the labels that distinguish stock records: storage dimensions such as site, warehouse and location, and tracking dimensions such as batch and serial numbers.

name: Inventory Visibility (Dynamics 365)
short: A Dynamics 365 service that gives a central, near real-time view of inventory across locations, legal entities and data sources and supports reservations.

name: IOPS
short: IOPS (input/output operations per second) measures how many read or write requests a storage system can handle each second.

name: IoT Hub device twin
short: State synchronization feature of Azure IoT Hub with desired properties written by the cloud and reported properties written by the device.

name: IoT Hub message routing
short: Azure IoT Hub feature that evaluates rules on message properties to send device-to-cloud messages to built-in or custom endpoints such as Event Hubs, storage or Fabric eventstreams.

name: iSCSI
short: iSCSI (Internet Small Computer Systems Interface) is a protocol that carries SCSI storage commands over IP networks, giving servers network access to block storage.

name: ISO/IEC 27001
short: The international standard published by ISO and IEC that specifies requirements for an information security management system (ISMS); organizations can be certified against it.

name: Isolated storage
short: Business Central data storage for key/value pairs that is isolated per extension, so other extensions cannot read the stored values; often used for secrets in development and test scenarios.

name: Jamf Pro

name: Java

name: JavaScript
short: The programming language of the web platform, used for front-end and back-end development.

name: Jira Service Management
short: Atlassian's IT service management product built on Jira, used to receive, route and resolve service requests and incidents; it can be integrated with Microsoft Teams.

name: JSON-RPC

name: JSON
short: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a plain-text data format of label-value pairs, objects and lists that almost every modern web API uses to exchange data.

name: Just-in-time access

name: Kaizen
short: A lean practice of small, practical improvements made close to the work, often run as short kaizen events or workshops by the people who run the process.

name: KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling)
short: KEDA is an open-source Kubernetes component that scales workloads based on events such as queue length or HTTP request rate, including scaling down to zero.

name: Key performance indicator (KPI)

name: Key person dependency
short: An operational risk where critical process knowledge or capability is concentrated in one or a few individuals, creating a single point of failure when they are absent or leave.

name: Keyword search
short: Traditional lexical search that matches the exact words of a query against documents, often ranked with the BM25 algorithm; precise for exact terms but blind to meaning.

name: Knowledge article
short: A reviewed support answer stored in the Dynamics 365 knowledge base that agents can search while working on a case and customers can read through a self-service portal.

name: Knowledge graph
short: A data model that represents entities and typed relationships explicitly so software can traverse connections, for example across production stages in a genealogy investigation.

name: Knowledge management
short: The organized process by which an organization creates, shares, uses and maintains its knowledge and information; the episode applies it to SharePoint as a company knowledge platform.

name: KRBTGT account
short: KRBTGT is the Active Directory account whose key the Key Distribution Center uses to sign Kerberos tickets; rotating its password twice invalidates forged tickets.

name: KRITIS (critical infrastructure)
short: KRITIS is the German term for critical infrastructure, such as energy, health or public administration, whose operators face stricter IT security and compliance requirements.

name: Kubernetes
short: Open-source container orchestration software that places packaged applications on computing resources and manages their execution.

name: Large language model (LLM)
short: A type of AI model trained on large amounts of text that generates likely text from patterns in its input; it powers conversational assistants such as Copilot.

name: Lateral movement

name: License plate (warehouse management)

name: Lift and shift
short: Lift and shift, also called rehosting, is a cloud migration approach that moves applications and data to the cloud with little or no change to their architecture.

name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator
short: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn's sales tool that can add relationship context such as mutual connections and company updates to Dynamics 365 Sales.

name: LinkedIn
short: LinkedIn is a professional networking and employment platform owned by Microsoft, widely used for recruiting, job searching and building professional visibility.

name: LINQ (Language Integrated Query)
short: LINQ (Language Integrated Query) is a set of .NET language features that adds query syntax to C# and Visual Basic across data sources such as collections and databases.

name: Llama
short: Llama is a family of large language models released by Meta AI, with open weights that can be downloaded and run on local hardware.

name: LlamaIndex
short: Open-source data framework for ingesting, indexing and retrieving data for large language model applications such as retrieval-augmented generation.

name: LLMLingua

name: LLMOps (large language model operations)

name: Location directive (Dynamics 365 warehouse management)
short: A configurable rule set in Dynamics 365 warehouse management that decides which location stock should be put away to or picked from, based on factors such as product, storage needs, zone and capacity.

name: Log Analytics
short: Azure Monitor tool and workspace for collecting, storing and querying log data from Azure, other clouds, on-premises servers and applications using Kusto Query Language (KQL).

name: Lotus 1-2-3

name: Machine learning
short: An approach in which a program learns patterns from examples instead of following rules written by hand, and uses them to make predictions.

name: MAI-1
short: In-house large language model family from Microsoft AI, built as a sparse mixture-of-experts model for deep, multi-step reasoning and offered as a cloud-hosted model.

name: Mail flow rule

name: Mainframe computer
short: A mainframe is a large, centralized computer shared by many users through terminals, with workloads queued and scheduled on one host.

name: Managed Environments
short: A suite of premium Power Platform capabilities that lets admins govern environments at scale, for example with usage insights, sharing limits and solution checking.

name: Managed identity
short: A managed identity is an identity for an application or Azure resource whose credentials Azure creates and rotates automatically, so no secret has to be stored in code or configuration files.

name: Managed service provider (MSP)
short: An outside company that a business hires to run and manage its IT or cloud environment on its behalf.

name: Markdown
short: Markdown is a lightweight markup language with plain-text formatting syntax; Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork store skills as Markdown (.md) files.

name: Market development funds (MDF)
short: Market development funds, also called co-op funds, are partner earnings that Microsoft sets aside for approved marketing and enablement activities and that must be spent within a set period.

name: Material requirements planning (MRP)
short: A planning calculation that works backward from demand through the bill of materials and creates planned supply signals where shortages appear.

name: Material UI
short: Open-source React component library that implements Google's Material Design and ships prebuilt, styled UI components.

name: Mathematical optimization
short: Searching through possible actions, such as schedules or resource assignments, to find options that satisfy stated constraints while improving a defined objective.

name: Maximum cut (Max-Cut)
short: Graph problem of partitioning the nodes into two groups so that the total weight of edges crossing between the groups is maximal; it is NP-hard in general and a common benchmark for QAOA.

name: Mean time to explain (MTTE)
short: A proposed operational metric for agentic AI systems: the time it takes to explain why a system behaved the way it did, as opposed to mean time to repair (MTTR) for deterministic failures.

name: Medallion architecture
short: A data design pattern that organizes lakehouse data into bronze (raw), silver (cleaned) and gold (consumption-ready) layers.

name: Memory poisoning
short: Memory poisoning is an attack in which malicious instructions are planted in content an AI agent stores in its persistent memory, so they resurface and influence later decisions.

short: A Teams Phone feature that acts as a virtual receptionist, greeting callers and routing them to the right person or call queue based on menu choices, time of day or holidays.

name: Teams call queues
short: Call queues in Microsoft Teams route incoming callers to groups of people in an organization who can help with a particular issue or question, sharing the incoming call volume.

name: Teams Calling Plans
short: Microsoft's PSTN offering for Teams Phone in which Microsoft acts as the carrier, supplying numbers and per-user minute bundles in a limited set of countries.

name: Teams certified devices

name: Microsoft Teams channels
short: Channels are the topic- or workflow-based spaces inside a Microsoft Teams team where members post conversations, share files and add tabs and apps.

name: Developer Portal for Teams
short: Microsoft's tool (formerly App Studio) for configuring, distributing and managing Microsoft Teams apps, including editing the app manifest.

name: Teams meeting apps
short: Custom Microsoft Teams apps that run inside a meeting, for example as an in-meeting side panel, a meeting tab or on the shared meeting stage. They use the meeting context, the app manifest and Teams s

name: Teams meeting lifecycle events
short: Event notifications that Microsoft Graph sends for Teams online meetings, such as call started, call ended and participant join or leave. Services subscribe to them via change notifications (webhooks)

name: Microsoft Teams meeting transcription
short: The Microsoft Teams feature that creates a live, speaker-attributed transcript of a meeting; Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams relies on it to produce meeting summaries and action items.

name: Message extensions (Microsoft Teams)
short: Teams app capability that lets users query or act on an external web service from the compose area and insert the results, usually as cards, into a conversation.

name: Personal tabs (Microsoft Teams)
short: A Microsoft Teams app surface that loads a web page for a single user, typically an existing web app embedded in the Teams client.

name: Teams templates
short: Predefined or custom Microsoft Teams structures with channels, tabs, apps and settings, managed in the Teams admin center, from which new teams can be created.

name: TeamsFx SDK
short: Microsoft SDK for building custom Microsoft Teams apps that has been deprecated; existing TeamsFx solutions need to be migrated, for example to SPFx or Power Apps as discussed in the episode.

name: Technical debt ratio (TDR)
short: A metric that expresses the cost to fix existing technical debt as a percentage of the total investment; in the episode it is applied to automation portfolios such as Power Automate flows.

name: Technical debt
short: Technical debt is the future cost of rework caused by choosing quick or ungoverned solutions instead of sound, maintainable ones.

name: Telemetry
short: A time-ordered record of repeated measurements sent by devices, such as machine sensor readings, whose meaning comes from the sequence rather than any single value.

name: Temporary Access Pass
short: Short-lived, time-limited passcode in Microsoft Entra that lets a user sign in for the first time and register passwordless methods such as the Authenticator app or a security key.

name: Tenant restrictions (Microsoft Entra)
short: Tenant restrictions in Microsoft Entra prevent users from signing in to other, external Microsoft 365 or Entra tenants with corporate devices or networks, reducing the risk of data exfiltration; unive

name: Terraform provider
short: A plugin that teaches Terraform how to talk to a single platform through its API, such as Azure, AWS or GitHub. Providers are distributed separately from Terraform and listed in the Terraform Registry

name: Terraform state
short: The record Terraform keeps of the infrastructure it manages, mapping resources in the configuration to real remote objects. Terraform uses it to decide which changes to make; it can contain sensitive

name: Thin client
short: A thin client is a simple computer optimized for connecting to a desktop or computing environment that runs remotely on a server or in the cloud.

name: Threat actor
short: A person or group carrying out cyberattacks; Microsoft tracks threat actors in profiles and names them by weather-themed families, using temporary Storm labels for groups still in development.

name: Threat analytics (Microsoft Defender XDR)
short: Threat analytics is the threat intelligence capability in Microsoft Defender XDR that provides reports by Microsoft security researchers on active threat actors, campaigns and attack techniques, inclu

name: Threat Explorer
short: A Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 tool for searching email detections, delivery actions and campaigns across a tenant.

name: Threat hunting
short: Threat hunting is the proactive search through security data for threats and suspicious activity that automated detections have not flagged, for example with queries in Microsoft Defender XDR.

name: Threat intelligence
short: Continuously updated information about known malicious IP addresses, domains and attack patterns that security tools use to alert on or block threats; Azure Firewall can filter traffic based on Micros

name: Threat modeling
short: Threat modeling is a structured security exercise in which developers and security experts review an application's design to identify what can go wrong and where security gaps are, ideally early in de

name: Three-way matching
short: An accounts payable control that compares the purchase order, the product receipt and the vendor invoice before an invoice is paid.

name: Time Entry Agent (Dynamics 365 Project Operations)
short: The Time Entry agent, part of the Time and Expense Agent in Dynamics 365 Project Operations, drafts weekly time entries from resource assignments and Outlook calendar data, reminds users in Microsoft

name: Time to decision
short: Time to decision is a metric that measures how long it takes from an identified issue to a committed action, used to show whether decision authority is flowing or pooling in a specific workflow.

name: Time to first token (TTFT)
short: A latency metric for generative AI systems that measures the time between a user submitting a request and the first token of the answer appearing.

name: TLS inspection
short: TLS inspection lets an organization decrypt and inspect selected encrypted web traffic under its policy so that content-based checks such as file filtering can be applied.

name: TLS termination
short: Ending the encrypted TLS connection at a proxy or load balancer such as a gateway, so back-end servers receive plain requests and certificates are managed in one place; also called TLS or SSL offloadi

name: Tabular Model Definition Language (TMDL)
short: TMDL is a human-readable, text-based syntax for defining tabular semantic models, including tables, measures and relationships, and can be used to store Power BI semantic models as a folder of text fi

name: Toil (operations)
short: Toil is repetitive, manual operational work, such as recurring alert triage or log analysis, that creates no lasting value and that site reliability and DevOps teams aim to reduce through automation.

name: Token protection (Conditional Access)
short: Token protection is a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access session control that binds sign-in session tokens to the device they were issued to, reducing token theft and replay attacks.

name: Token theft
short: Token theft is an attack in which an adversary steals and replays a user's session or access token, for example after adversary-in-the-middle phishing, to act as the user without needing the password

name: Tool contract
short: Standardized, versioned definition of an action an AI agent may call, specifying allowed inputs, structured outputs, executing identity, provenance logging and approval gates for irreversible steps, s

name: Total cost of ownership (TCO)
short: Total cost of ownership (TCO) is the full cost of a system over its lifetime, including operations, maintenance, staffing and infrastructure, not only the initial purchase or migration cost.

name: Traceability
short: The ability to follow the recorded history of material and products through receipt, production and delivery, for example to support recall and containment decisions in manufacturing.

name: Trainable classifiers
short: Machine-learning classifiers in Microsoft Purview that learn to recognize a kind of document, such as contracts or source code, from example documents, and can be used as conditions in DLP and labelin

name: Transact-SQL (T-SQL)
short: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) is Microsoft's extension of SQL used by Microsoft SQL Server and related SQL products and services.

name: Transactional outbox pattern
short: An integration pattern in which a change to a record and a matching entry in a dedicated outbox table are written in the same transaction, so a downstream service can reliably pick up and process ever

name: Triple peak workday
short: The triple peak workday is a pattern described in Microsoft research in which knowledge work activity peaks not only in the morning and afternoon but again in the late evening.

name: Truesec
short: Truesec is a cybersecurity company providing services such as penetration testing, incident response and proactive security.

name: Trunk-based development
short: A source-control practice in which developers commit small changes to one shared branch, the trunk, at least daily, with branches living for hours rather than weeks.

name: Trusted Platform Module (TPM)
short: A security chip on a device's motherboard; Windows Autopilot pre-provisioning and self-deploying modes require TPM attestation to prove the device's identity.

name: TypeScript
short: A programming language from Microsoft that builds on JavaScript with static types to catch mistakes early; it is used to write Power Apps code components.

name: Unattended desktop flow
short: A desktop flow run mode in which the bot signs in to a free machine without a user present; it requires a paid unattended license and cannot run while any user session is open or with elevated rights.

name: Unconstrained delegation

name: Unified customer profile
short: A unified customer profile combines matched and de-duplicated records about the same person from several source systems into one profile, sometimes called a golden record, while keeping track of where

name: Unified namespace (UNS)
short: An architecture pattern providing a governed, shared event space, typically on an MQTT broker, where machine data and other current factory events are published once and consumed by any approved syste

name: Unified routing (Dynamics 365)
short: Unified routing in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center sends incoming cases and conversations to the most suitable queue or service representative based on rules, skills, presence and cap

name: Unified Tenant Configuration Management (UTCM)
short: Set of Microsoft Graph APIs, introduced in preview in 2026, for taking baseline snapshots of Microsoft 365 tenant configuration and monitoring the live tenant for configuration drift.

name: Unit economics
short: Measuring costs (and value) per unit of work rather than in aggregate; in this episode applied to AI as cost per decision, cost per insight or cost per automated workflow.

name: Unit testing
short: A software testing practice that checks small, isolated pieces of code such as a single method or function against expected behavior; fast and cheap, but blind to integration and user-interface failur

name: Unity Catalog
short: The governance layer of Databricks that provides centralized access control, auditing, lineage and discovery across workspaces.

name: Unstructured data
short: Information that does not follow a predefined data model, such as chat messages, meeting transcripts and documents, which large language models can now analyze for patterns.

name: User-defined routes (UDR)
short: Custom routes in an Azure route table, associated with a subnet, that override Azure's default system routes, for example to send outbound traffic through a firewall or virtual appliance as the next h

name: User experience (UX) design
short: User experience design is a user-centered approach to designing products around usability, accessibility and how people perceive and use them; in the episode it is applied to Power Apps business appli

name: Value stream mapping
short: A lean method for visualizing how material, information and decisions flow through a product family, including process steps, queues and handoffs.

name: VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA)
short: VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) is an EU legislative package that modernises the VAT system with three pillars: digital reporting and e-invoicing, platform economy rules and single VAT registration. The

name: Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
short: Microsoft event-driven programming language built into most desktop Microsoft Office applications, used for example to automate tasks in Excel.

name: Vector search
short: Vector search finds data by similarity of embeddings rather than exact matches and is a foundation for retrieval-augmented AI applications; Azure SQL Database and SQL Server 2025 support it natively.

name: Vector store
short: A database optimized for searching embeddings by meaning rather than exact words, used as memory for retrieval-augmented generation.

name: Veeam
short: Veeam is a vendor of third-party backup and recovery software for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

name: Vendor posting profile
short: In Dynamics 365, a vendor posting profile defines which general ledger accounts vendor transactions post to, based on rules set for a vendor or vendor group.

name: Verifiable credentials
short: Digital credentials based on W3C open standards that let an issuer make a claim about a holder, which the holder can present and a verifier can check, optionally disclosing only what is needed.

name: VertiPaq engine
short: VertiPaq is the in-memory columnar storage engine used by Power BI import models, which compresses data column by column for fast queries.

name: Vibe engineering
short: Term for disciplined, AI-assisted software and agent development in which experienced engineers own setup, security and governance, contrasted in the episode with casual vibe coding.

name: Virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI)
short: Virtual desktop infrastructure hosts desktops on central servers or in the cloud, and users connect to them remotely; user profiles and app data must load quickly from central storage.

name: Virtual machine
short: A complete computer simulated inside another computer, with its own operating system, memory and storage; it offers stronger isolation than a container but is larger and slower to start.

name: Virtual network (VNet) data gateway
short: A Microsoft-managed data gateway that connects Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to data sources inside an Azure virtual network, without installing gateway software on a machine.

name: Azure virtual network peering

name: Virtual network service endpoints
short: An Azure Virtual Network feature that restricts access to Azure services so only traffic from a chosen virtual network subnet is allowed, while the service keeps its public endpoint.

name: Virtual private network (VPN)
short: A virtual private network (VPN) creates an encrypted tunnel from a remote device into a private network over an untrusted network such as the internet, traditionally used for remote access to company

name: Virtual table data provider
short: Component that translates Dataverse requests for a virtual table into calls to an external system and returns the results as Dataverse rows; Dataverse includes an OData v4 provider and supports custom

name: Viva Amplify
short: Microsoft Viva app for corporate communicators that centralizes campaign management, publishing and reporting across channels such as Outlook, Teams and SharePoint.

name: Viva Connections
short: Microsoft Viva app that serves as the employee experience front door, bringing company news, resources and tools into a dashboard inside Microsoft Teams.

name: Viva Glint
short: Microsoft Viva app for organization-wide employee engagement surveys with benchmarking and analytics.

name: VLAN
short: A virtual local area network divides a switched network into separate logical networks; enforcing access between VLANs still requires routed controls such as firewalls.

name: VMware
short: VMware is a virtualization vendor whose vCenter-managed virtual machines are one of the main on-premises sources that Azure Migrate discovers, assesses and replicates.

name: Voucher (accounting)
short: In Dynamics 365 Finance, a shared reference that links a source document, its subledger accounting entries and the resulting general ledger entries, so amounts can be traced back to their origin.

name: Vulnerability management
short: Vulnerability management is the ongoing process of identifying, prioritizing and remediating security weaknesses in software and systems, closely tied to patch management.

name: Weak ties
short: Weak ties are looser relationships with people outside one’s close working circle; they connect different groups and let information, help and innovation travel across an organization.

name: Web resources (model-driven apps)
short: Web resources are files such as JavaScript, HTML or CSS stored in Dataverse and used to extend model-driven app forms; PCF code components are the more governed, modern alternative.

name: Web roles (Power Pages)
short: Web roles in Microsoft Power Pages are sets of permissions assigned to site users, such as authenticated or anonymous users, that control access to site pages and, together with table permissions, to

name: WebAuthn
short: Web Authentication (WebAuthn) is a W3C web standard that gives websites an API to authenticate users with public-key credentials such as passkeys instead of passwords.

name: WebSocket
short: WebSocket is a communications protocol that provides a persistent, two-way channel over a single TCP connection; the episode contrasts it with polling-based connectors.

name: Who knows whom (Dynamics 365 Sales)
short: Who knows whom is a Dynamics 365 Sales relationship intelligence feature that suggests colleagues who have previously communicated with a lead or contact, enabling warm introductions.

name: Windows 365 Frontline
short: A version of Windows 365 for shift and part-time workers in which one license serves Cloud PCs used by several people at different times, so organizations pay for concurrency rather than headcount.

name: Windows 365 Link
short: Windows 365 Link is a Microsoft hardware device built to connect users directly to their Windows 365 Cloud PC, without local apps, user files or a local admin account.

name: Windows App
short: Windows App is Microsoft's client app for connecting to Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Microsoft Dev Box, Remote Desktop Services and remote PCs from Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and web browsers

name: Windows Autopatch
short: A Microsoft managed service that sits on top of Intune and Windows Update for Business, creating update rings, monitoring rollouts and pausing them when health signals turn bad. Policy decisions, excl

name: Windows Autopilot Device Preparation
short: The newer, simpler flavor of Windows Autopilot that groups and configures a device the moment it enrolls, without pre-registering a hardware hash; it supports Microsoft Entra join only and runs on Win

name: Windows Autopilot
short: A collection of Microsoft technologies used to set up and pre-configure new Windows devices and enroll them into Microsoft Intune, with deployment modes such as user-driven, self-deploying and pre-pro

name: Windows Enterprise multi-session
short: A Windows 10/11 Enterprise edition for Azure Virtual Desktop that lets multiple users hold interactive sessions on one virtual machine at the same time. Its use depends on eligible Windows Enterprise

name: Windows Hello for Business
short: The managed business version of Windows Hello that replaces passwords with a device-bound key pair, unlocked by a PIN or biometrics, to sign users into Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory work acco

name: Windows LAPS
short: Windows Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) gives every device a unique, regularly rotated local administrator password stored in the directory with restricted read access.

name: Recall (Windows)
short: An opt-in Windows feature on Copilot+ PCs that saves encrypted snapshots of the screen locally and lets users search their past activity in natural language.

name: Windows Server Update Services (WSUS)
short: A Windows Server role for downloading, approving and distributing Microsoft updates from an internal server; Configuration Manager uses it for patch management.

name: Windows Server
short: Microsoft's server operating system, whose licensing can be applied at the physical host level and, where eligible, used in Azure via Azure Hybrid Benefit.

name: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)
short: A Windows feature that runs a Linux environment directly on a Windows PC without a separate traditional virtual machine or dual-boot setup; WSL 2 uses a real Linux kernel in a lightweight virtual mach

name: Windows Update for Business
short: A set of policy controls built into Windows that lets organizations defer updates, set installation deadlines and control restarts, with devices downloading updates directly from Windows Update.

name: WinUI
short: WinUI is Microsoft's native XAML-based UI framework for Windows desktop apps and part of the Windows App SDK.

name: Work in progress (WIP)
short: Work in progress is material or product that has started its production route but is not yet finished; too much WIP ties up material and space and hides problems in the flow.

name: Work IQ
short: Work IQ is Microsoft's intelligence layer that grounds Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents in an organization's work context and data.

name: Work order
short: A job record that follows a maintenance or repair task from the first report to completion, holding tasks, assigned workers, required parts, status and costs.

name: Workday
short: Workday is a cloud-based enterprise application suite from Workday, Inc. for human capital management and finance, built around configurable business processes, routing and approvals.

name: Workload identity federation
short: Workload identity federation lets workloads outside Azure, such as GitHub Actions pipelines, exchange a trusted external token for a short-lived Microsoft Entra access token without storing secrets.

name: Workplace loneliness
short: Workplace loneliness describes low connection, thin trust and weak relational redundancy among people at work, which can persist even in highly connected and productive teams.

name: Works council
short: Elected body of employee representatives that, in Germany and other EU countries, holds information, consultation or co-determination rights over workplace changes such as technical monitoring systems

name: Workstream (Dynamics 365)
short: A workstream in Dynamics 365 unified routing defines how one kind of incoming work, such as chat, voice, messaging or records, is taken in, classified, routed to queues and assigned to agents.

name: Wortell
short: Dutch Microsoft partner where Femke Cornelissen works as Chief Transformation Officer.

name: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF)
short: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) is Microsoft's XAML-based UI framework for building Windows desktop applications on .NET.

name: X++
short: The programming language used to develop and customize Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (formerly Dynamics AX/Axapta).

name: X.509 certificate
short: A standard digital certificate format; devices can prove their identity with an X.509 certificate and private key, for example during the TLS handshake with Azure IoT Hub.

name: XRM Tools
short: A Visual Studio extension created by Reza Niroomand that lets developers define and register Power Platform (Dataverse) plug-ins and custom APIs as code, for example through C# attributes.

name: xUnit.net
short: A free, open-source unit testing framework for .NET languages such as C#, F# and Visual Basic, also used for integration tests.

name: YAML
short: YAML is a human-readable text format for configuration files that relies on spacing and indentation; GitHub Actions workflows are written in it.

name: YubiKey
short: YubiKey is a hardware security key made by Yubico that can store passkeys and serve as a phishing-resistant backup credential.

name: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP)
short: A Microsoft email protection capability that re-evaluates delivered messages and moves them to junk or quarantine when their verdict later changes to phishing or malware.

name: Zombie apps
short: Applications or flows that were created and then abandoned but never retired, so they keep their data connections and permissions, consume resources and create attack surface without delivering value.

name: Zoned governance
short: A governance model that groups environments into risk zones, often green, yellow and red, with increasing restrictions and IT approval from personal experimentation to production agents.

name: Industry 4.0
short: The networked, data-driven digitalization of industrial production, in which machines, products, software and people exchange data in real time; often called the smart factory or the fourth industrial

name: Swimlane diagram
short: A process diagram that arranges the steps of a business process in parallel lanes, one per role, team or system, so that responsibilities and handoffs become visible.

name: Aerospace
short: The industry that designs, builds and maintains aircraft, spacecraft and their components, characterised by strict quality, traceability and certification requirements.

name: Manufacturing
short: The industry that turns raw materials and components into physical goods, from single parts to series production, in factories and workshops.

name: Automotive
short: The industry that develops, produces and supplies vehicles and their parts, including manufacturers and the supplier chain behind them.

name: Mechanical engineering
short: The industry that designs and builds machines, plants and mechanical components for other industries.

name: IT services
short: The industry of companies that plan, implement, run and support IT systems and software for other organisations.

name: Consulting
short: The industry of advisory firms and independent consultants who help organisations with strategy, processes, technology and change.

name: Public sector
short: The part of the economy made up of government bodies, authorities and publicly owned organisations that provide public services.

name: Healthcare
short: The industry covering hospitals, practices, care providers, health insurers and related services that look after people's health.

name: Financial services
short: The industry of banks, insurers, asset managers and other providers of financial products and services, subject to strict regulation.

name: Retail
short: The industry that sells goods to consumers or businesses, in stores, online or both.

name: Education
short: The sector of schools, universities, training providers and other institutions that teach and train people.

name: Energy
short: The industry that produces, transports and supplies electricity, gas, heat and other forms of energy.

name: Logistics
short: The industry that plans and carries out the transport, storage and handling of goods and the information flows around them.

name: Microsoft 365 administrator
short: Manages the Microsoft 365 tenant of an organisation, including users, licences, security settings and the core services such as Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams.

name: SharePoint architect
short: Designs the structure, governance and integration of SharePoint and related Microsoft 365 content and collaboration solutions.

name: Power Platform developer
short: Builds apps, automations and reports with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Copilot Studio, often with connectors and Dataverse.

name: Copilot / AI consultant
short: Advises organisations on introducing Microsoft Copilot and other AI solutions, from use cases and data readiness to governance and adoption.

name: IT manager
short: Leads the IT team and IT operations of an organisation and is responsible for its systems, budget, projects and service quality.

name: CIO
short: Chief information officer: the executive responsible for information technology and digital strategy of an organisation.

name: Marketing manager
short: Plans and runs marketing activities such as campaigns, content, events and channels to reach and grow an audience or customer base.

name: Managing director
short: Runs a company as its legal and executive head and is responsible for its strategy, results and compliance. Corresponds to the German Geschäftsführer.

name: Solution architect
short: Designs end-to-end technical solutions that meet business requirements and fit an organisation's existing systems and standards.

name: Security engineer
short: Designs, implements and monitors security controls, such as identity protection, endpoint security and threat detection, to protect systems and data.

name: Teams administrator
short: Manages Microsoft Teams in an organisation, including policies, meetings, calling, devices and governance of teams and channels.

name: Data analyst
short: Collects, cleans and analyses data and presents the findings in reports and dashboards, for example with Power BI, to support decisions.
